REED-STRIKE.title: Strike
REED-DEFEND.title: Defend
REED-SCORCH.title: Scorch
REED-IGNITE_FIRE.title: Kindling
REED-IGNITE_FIRE.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Basic[/gold] Spark.
Add a [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold] to your hand.
REED-BONFIRE.title: Bonfire
REED-POEM.title: Poem
REED-POEM.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card from your hand. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {Block:diff()} times its Energy cost.
REED-PATROL.title: Trace
REED-THORN.title: Sting
REED-THORN.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage to the target in [red]Burning State[/red].
REED-ASHES.title: Ember
REED-FORGE.title: Forge
REED-FORGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Basic[/gold] Spark.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
REED-WAY_BACK.title: The Way Back
REED-WAY_BACK.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Patrol[/gold] Spark.
Whenever a Spark Card Bursts, this card costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} the next time you play.
REED-OVERLOOK.title: Overlook
REED-OVERLOOK.description: Record {Cards:diff()} [gold]Defend+[/gold] cards in [blue]next turn's[/blue] Memory, then [gold]Recall[/gold] a card from it.
REED-REGRET.title: Regret
REED-REGRET.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a card that can initiate [gold]Recall[/gold], return this card from your discard pile to your hand.
REED-TIME_FIRE.title: Flame of Time
REED-TIME_FIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase the damage of all Attacks in [gold]Memory[/gold] by {Increase:diff()}.
REED-CANDLE_NIGHT.title: Candlelit Night
REED-CANDLE_NIGHT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
When this card is recorded in [gold]Memory[/gold], add a [gold]Flame Light[/gold] to your hand.
REED-SQUAMA.title: Dragon Scale
REED-SQUAMA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards to your hand.
REED-LIVING_ELEGY.title: Elegy for the Living
REED-TOWARD_LIFE.title: Toward the Firelight
REED-TOWARD_LIFE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Target yourself or an enemy. [gold]Detonate[/gold] one of the target's Spark Cards to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
REED-AS_SHADOW.title: Like a Shadow
REED-AS_SHADOW.description:
Apply to all enemies.
[red]Burning State[/red]: Restore {Repeat:diff()} Resistance.
Otherwise, [gold]Burn[/gold] {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-DRAGON_OATH.title: Oath of the Red Dragon
REED-DRAGON_OATH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.{IfUpgraded:show:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Cinder[/gold] Spark.
[blue]Downgrade[/blue] this card.|
[gold]Detonate[/gold] a Spark Card.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] this card.}
REED-LAST_PAGE.title: Final Page
REED-LAST_PAGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Increase this card's cost by 1 and the amount of {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} it grants by 1.
REED-LATENT_DETECTION.title: Latent Awareness
REED-LATENT_DETECTION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If not played by Recall, record this card in [gold]Memory[/gold] for each of the next {Repeat:diff()} turns. At the start of each corresponding turn, [gold]Recall[/gold] that record.
REED-HATE.title: Red Dragon's Hate
REED-HATE.description:
Until it next leaves [red]Burning State[/red], the Resistance it loses and restores is increased by {HatePower:diff()}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
REED-BACKGROUND.title: Origins
REED-BACKGROUND.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
[gold]Recall[/gold] a card that can initiate Recall from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-HER_SHADOW.title: Her Shadow
REED-HER_SHADOW.description:
[gold]Burn[/gold] all enemies {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold] cards to your hand.
REED-BRAVE_SHINE.title: Everlasting Radiance
REED-BRAVE_SHINE.description:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards to your hand.
Your [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards deal {LightPower:diff()} additional damage.
REED-AS_TORCH.title: Like a Torch
REED-AS_TORCH.description: The next time an enemy enters [red]Burning State[/red], its [gold]Spark Cards[/gold] Burst {AsTorchPower:diff()} additional times.
REED-HER_FLAME.title: Her Flame
REED-HER_FLAME.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, [gold]Burn[/gold] a random enemy {HerFlamePower:diff()}, prioritizing enemies not in Burning State.
REED-CURSE_HEAL.title: Curseheal
REED-CURSE_HEAL.description: Whenever your cards deal damage, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to 25% of the damage dealt.
REED-SPREAD.title: Spread
REED-SPREAD.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] a Spark Card.
{IfUpgraded:show:With 150% damage, }apply its effect to all enemies.
REED-BURN_ME.title: What the Firelight Casts
REED-BURN_ME.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-BORN_FLOWER.title: Flowers from Withered Flames
REED-BORN_FLOWER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Recall[/gold] a Skill from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-HEART_KNOT.title: Heart Knot
REED-HEART_KNOT.description: Whenever you play a card automatically, gain {HeartKnotPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-TO_DUST.title: Return to Dust
REED-TO_DUST.description: Record a random card from each turn in [gold]Memory[/gold] into [blue]the current turn[/blue], then [gold]Recall[/gold] a {IfUpgraded:show:Attack or }Skill from those records.
REED-CONSCIOUS.title: Insight
REED-CONSCIOUS.description:
If an enemy intends to attack, reduce its [gold]Strength[/gold] by {StrengthPower:diff()}.
When played automatically, affect all enemies instead.
REED-WITH_YOU.title: Together with You
REED-WITH_YOU.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {ExtraBlock:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each card recorded in [blue]the current turn's[/blue] [gold]Memory[/gold].
REED-ASHLESS.title: Unspent
REED-ASHLESS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
When played automatically, target random enemies and deal damage {Repeat:diff()} additional times.
REED-EMPEROR_TRAVEL.title: Footsteps of Kings
REED-EMPEROR_TRAVEL.description: [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory. Whenever you play an Attack, Recall this card (treating it as the previous turn).
REED-CRACK.title: Disintegrate
REED-CRACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Record this card in [gold]Memory[/gold] for each of the next {Repeat:diff()} turns.
REED-RUINS.title: Ruins
REED-RUINS.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Record this card in [gold]Memory[/gold] for each of the next {Repeat:diff()} turns.
REED-WRITE_HISTORY.title: Write History
REED-WRITE_HISTORY.description:
Discard any number of cards from your hand and record them in [blue]the current turn's[/blue] [gold]Memory[/gold].
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card discarded.
REED-FROM_HISTORY.title: From History
REED-FROM_HISTORY.description: Whenever you [gold]Recall[/gold], record {FromHistoryPower:diff()} random cards in the [blue]Recalled turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-FOREVER_HEART.title: Flameheart
REED-FOREVER_HEART.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has 2 Spark Cards of the same name, attach another Spark Card of that name to it.
REED-FOREVER_HEART.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Cards:diff()} cards to attach to enemies
REED-TO_THE_DEATH.title: For the Departed
REED-TO_THE_DEATH.description: [gold]Recall[/gold] an {IfUpgraded:show:Attack or }Skill from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory, then record it in the current turn.
REED-NATURAL_HISTORY.title: Curator
REED-NATURAL_HISTORY.description: For every 10 cards you [gold]Recall[/gold] or record, draw {NaturalHistoryPower:diff()} cards.
REED-ALIVE_DRAW.title: Vivid Scenes
REED-ALIVE_DRAW.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Shine[/gold] Spark.
Next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
REED-HEART_CLEAR.title: Heart Clear
REED-HEART_CLEAR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this card is in Memory, whenever you [gold]Recall[/gold] another card from [blue]the current turn[/blue], Recall this card as well.
REED-DEAD_CROWN.title: Withered Branches and Laurels
REED-DEAD_CROWN.description:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to all enemies.
Whenever a creature dies, return this card from your exhaust pile to your hand.
REED-MELT_CALAMITY.title: Molten Calamity
REED-LIGHT_FLOW.title: Flow of Light
REED-LIGHT_FLOW.description: [gold]Recall[/gold] a Skill from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory. Whenever another card is played during this card's resolution, add a [gold]Flame Light[/gold] to your hand.
REED-A_CORNER.title: A Corner
REED-A_CORNER.description: Reveal {Cards:diff()} random cards each from your draw pile and discard pile. Choose any number to put on top of your draw pile; record the rest in [blue]the current turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-A_CORNER.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose any number of cards to put on top of your draw pile. Record the rest in [blue]the current turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-OLD_FIRE.title: Flame of Yore
REED-OLD_FIRE.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Basic[/gold] Spark.
Increase the damage of all its Spark Cards by {Increase:diff()}. [gold]Evolved[/gold] Spark Cards gain an additional {Increase:diff()} damage.
REED-THE_CHASER.title: The Lightseeker's Dawn
REED-THE_CHASER.description:
Enchant a card in your hand with [purple]Chasing Light[/purple].
Your [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards deal {LightPower:diff()} additional damage.
REED-THE_DUBLIN.title: What Is Dublinn?
REED-THE_DUBLIN.description:
Gain {RecallPower:diff()} [gold]Pending Recall[/gold].
When this card is [gold]Recalled[/gold], add a copy of it to your discard pile.
REED-FOREVER_FLAME.title: Drowning in Flames
REED-FOREVER_FLAME.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and [gold]Burn[/gold] {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
If the target is still not in [red]Burning State[/red], repeat against a random enemy, up to 2 additional times.
REED-DRAGON_CROWN.title: A Wreath for the Red Dragon
REED-DRAGON_CROWN.description: For up to {DragonCrownPower:diff()} cards each turn, you can play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [gold]Status[/gold] cards in your hand and draw a card, even if those Status cards are unplayable.
REED-WISH_AND_CURSE.title: Blessing and Curse
REED-WISH_AND_CURSE.description: Discard any number of cards from your hand and draw that many cards. If all discarded cards are of different types, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] them instead.
REED-ENDER_WALKER.title: The Final Road
REED-ENDER_WALKER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If not played by Recall, record this card in [gold]Memory[/gold] for each of the next {Repeat:diff()} turns. At the start of each corresponding turn, [gold]Recall[/gold] that record.
REED-INC_FIRE.title: Kindle Anew
REED-INC_FIRE.description:
For each point of [gold]Burn[/gold] the target receives this turn, increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by {IncFirePower:diff()}.
Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]damage[/gold] and [gold]Burn[/gold] {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-ELEGY.title: Elegy
REED-ELEGY.description: Each turn, the first time you [gold]Attach[/gold] a card to a creature, gain {ElegyPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-FLAME_SUN.title: Flame Sun
REED-FLAME_SUN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
When you are attacked this turn, [gold]Burn[/gold] the attacker {FlameSunPower:diff()}.
REED-FLAME_MOON.title: Flame Moon
REED-FLAME_MOON.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
If its Spark Card count is below the limit or it can [gold]Evolve[/gold], [gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Shine[/gold] Spark.
REED-INVITATION_TO_DANCE.title: Invitation to Dance
REED-INVITATION_TO_DANCE.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Patrol[/gold] Spark.
Transform one of the target's {IfUpgraded:show:non-Patrol|[gold]Basic[/gold]} Sparks into a [gold]Patrol[/gold] Spark.
REED-DRIVE_DEATH.title: Drive Death
REED-DRIVE_DEATH.description:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
If you have not removed a Spark Card this turn, [gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Patrol[/gold] Spark.
REED-MULTI_ONE.description: Choose an ally. They [gold]Recall[/gold] an {IfUpgraded:show:any card|Attack or Skill} from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-DYING_FIRE.title: Dying Flame
REED-DYING_FIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce the target's maximum [gold]Resistance[/gold] by {Repeat:diff()}.
REED-SAME_BREATH.title: Wither and Thrive
REED-SAME_BREATH.description: Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards to your hand and give them [gold]Everburning[/gold].
REED-CHASE_FIRE.title: Chase the Flame
REED-CHASE_FIRE.description:
Increase the Spark Card limit to 4.
Whenever you [gold]Burn[/gold] an enemy in [red]Burning State[/red], increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by the same amount.
REED-LIVING_FIRE.title: Living Spark
REED-LIVING_FIRE.description:
Gain [gold]Curseheal[/gold] while playing this card.
Attach a [gold]Cinder[/gold] Spark to all enemies and [gold]Burn[/gold] them {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-IRELAND.title: “Tara”
REED-IRELAND.description: Choose a [gold]Spark Card[/gold] attached to an enemy and [gold]Evolve[/gold] it immediately.
REED-DRAGON_BLOOD.title: Dragon Blood
REED-DRAGON_BLOOD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
[gold]Detonate[/gold] the first Spark Card attached to each enemy, making it Burst {Repeat:diff()} additional times.
REED-TURBID_BURN.title: Turbid Flames
REED-TURBID_BURN.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Shine[/gold] Spark to yourself.
Whenever you play an Attack, [gold]Burn[/gold] all creatures {TurbidBurnPower:diff()}.
REED-HERO_EPIC.title: Heroic Epic
REED-HERO_EPIC.description: If played by [gold]Recall[/gold], choose a turn in Memory and [gold]Recall[/gold] all cards in it that cannot initiate Recall.
REED-CLASH.title: Last Vestiges
REED-CLASH.description:
For each different card type among the other cards in your hand, deal {Damage:diff()} damage and [gold]Burn[/gold] {Reed_Burn:diff()}.{InCombat:
(Attack {CalculatedCards:diff()} times)|}
REED-SPEAK_TO_TERRA.title: Speak to the Earth
REED-SPEAK_TO_TERRA.description: Record a card from your hand in the Memory of [blue]turn 0[/blue] of every combat, then [gold]Recall[/gold] an {IfUpgraded:show:Attack or }Skill from it.
REED-AS_NIGHT_ENDS.title: As Night Falls Away
REED-AS_NIGHT_ENDS.description:
The next time an enemy enters [red]Burning State[/red], its [gold]Spark Cards[/gold] Burst X additional times.
Add {IfUpgraded:show:X+2|X} [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold] cards to your hand.
REED-OVER_COLD_NIGHT.title: Through the Cold Night
REED-OVER_COLD_NIGHT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Record this card in [gold]Memory[/gold] for the previous turn and each of the next {Repeat:diff()} turns.
REED-FACE_PAST.title: Face the Past
REED-FACE_PAST.description:
Gain [gold]Curseheal[/gold] while playing this card.
[gold]Recall[/gold] a non-Power card from each of the previous {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} turns, in order.
REED-LIGHT_SHADOW.title: Light and Shadow
REED-LIGHT_SHADOW.description: Whenever a creature enters or leaves [red]Burning State[/red], add a [gold]Flame Light[/gold] or [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold], respectively, to your hand.
REED-DEAD_FIRE.title: Dead Fire
REED-DEAD_FIRE.description: {IfUpgraded:show:At 150% damage, }[gold]Detonate[/gold] all enemies' Spark Cards. Combine the removed Spark Cards, then randomly [gold]Attach[/gold] them to enemies.
REED-WHICH_LIVING.title: Life and Death
REED-WHICH_LIVING.description:
Choose to enter [green]Living[/green] or [purple]Dying[/purple].
[gold]Burn[/gold] away all enemies' Resistance.
REED-STEP_AND_STEP.title: Keep Moving Forward
REED-STEP_AND_STEP.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill from [blue]turn 1[/blue] of Memory, then advance the turn number by 1.
REED-REKINDLE.title: Rekindle
REED-REKINDLE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack from the earliest turn in Memory that has an Attack recorded.
REED-WHERE_SPIRITS_GO.title: Where Spirits Go
REED-WHERE_SPIRITS_GO.description: Choose an enemy. You and all allies, in sequence, each [gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Cinder[/gold] Spark to that enemy and [gold]Burn[/gold] it {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-PROLONG_DAYS.title: Prolong the Day
REED-PROLONG_DAYS.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] all Spark Cards on the target.
[gold]Attach[/gold] an equal number of [gold]Patrol[/gold] Sparks; Evolved cards instead attach a [gold]Flag[/gold] Spark.
REED-IGNITE_LIFE.title: Spark of Life
REED-IGNITE_LIFE.description:
[gold]Attach[/gold] a [gold]Cinder[/gold] Spark.
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold] cards to your hand.
REED-UNTIL_DEATH.title: Until the Flames Burn Out
REED-UNTIL_DEATH.description: Whenever an enemy leaves [red]Burning State[/red], trigger the Burst effect of one of its random [gold]Spark[/gold] Cards.
REED-LIVING_ALIVE.title: Living
REED-LIVING_ALIVE.description: Transform the Spark Cards you have attached to other creatures into [green]Living Form[/green]. They grant you defensive benefits.
REED-LIVING_DEAD.title: Dying
REED-LIVING_DEAD.description: Transform the Spark Cards you have attached to other creatures into [purple]Dying Form[/purple]. They grant you offensive benefits.
REED-FLAME_SHADOW.title: Flame Shadow
REED-FLAME_SHADOW.description:
[gold]Burn[/gold] {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
When this card leaves your hand, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
REED-FLAME_LIGHT.title: Flame Light
REED-FLAME_LIGHT.description: When this card leaves your hand, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it. When Exhausted, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies.
REED-NORMAL_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Basic
REED-NORMAL_FLOWER.description: [gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage{Alive:, grant the source {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]|}{Dead:, grant the source {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]|}.
REED-END_FLOWER.title: [Spark] End
REED-END_FLOWER.description: [gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage{Alive:, grant the source {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]|}{Dead:, grant the source {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]|}.
REED-SHINE_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Shine
REED-SHINE_FLOWER.description: [gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage and make the source draw {Cards:diff()} cards{Alive:, reducing the cost of Skills drawn by 1 this turn|}{Dead:, reducing the cost of Attacks drawn by 2 this turn|}.
REED-SPLENDID_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Splendid
REED-SPLENDID_FLOWER.description: [gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage, make the source draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}{Alive:, reducing the cost of Skills drawn by 1 this turn|}{Dead:, reducing the cost of Attacks drawn by 2 this turn|}.
REED-BURN_MARK_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Cinder
REED-BURN_MARK_FLOWER.description:
[gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Continuous[/gold]: Deal {Alive:40|25}% less Attack damage and take {Dead:40|25}% more Attack damage.
REED-BLAZE_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Blaze
REED-BLAZE_FLOWER.description:
[gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Continuous[/gold]: Deal {Alive:60|40}% less Attack damage and take {Dead:60|40}% more Attack damage.
REED-PATROL_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Patrol
REED-PATROL_FLOWER.description:
[gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage.
When this card is removed, grant the source {Energy:energyIcons()}{Alive: and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]|}{Dead: and {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]|}.
REED-FLAG_FLOWER.title: [Spark] Flag
REED-FLAG_FLOWER.description:
[gold]Burst[/gold]: Take {Damage:diff()} damage.
When this card is removed, grant the source {Energy:energyIcons()}{Alive: and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]|}{Dead: and {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold]|}.
